Biome_1_Arid.inferential_degrees_of_freedom: df <= 2 (governed by 3 in-domain Serbian tile clusters; at most 27 ordered resamples, 10 unique multisets)
Biome_1_Arid.methodological_caveat: Three geographic clusters provide limited independent geographic replication. The 2,000 bootstrap iterations represent numerical integration of this 10-multiset space, not 2,000 independent geographic replicates. Statistical conclusions are exploratory/descriptive and strictly conditional on the Serbian reference tiles.
